lines.speaker: stacks_swimmer
lines.text: Line's mine till the light goes. You can cross on it if you're quick and you keep your weight off the middle — it's spliced there and the splice is older than me.

lines.speaker: stacks_swimmer
lines.text: Everyone here swims. My mother's mother's mother learned on the causeway, off a woman who told her straight that the water was coming, and then taught her anyway, which I've always thought was the impressive half.

lines.speaker: stacks_swimmer
lines.text: Sana, her name was. That's the whole record. Nobody knows another thing about her — not where she came from, not what happened to her. We've got a line named after her and four generations who can swim.
